title: Errands, shopping & technology
description: Hand-selected conversational vocabulary with contextual Mandarin examples.

cards.english: Turn off a phone or computer
to exchange; to change (clothes etc); to substitute
classifier indicating a small amount or small number greater than 1: some, a few, several
Know how to; will; be likely to
to live; to dwell; to stay
just recently; just a moment ago
just at (that time); right in (that place); right in the middle of (doing sth)

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ shōu dào yī fēng xìn.
grammar.english: I received a letter.

grammar.pinyin: Jīn tiān tài máng, wǒ chī fāng biàn miàn.
grammar.english: I'm too busy today, so I'll eat instant noodles.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng shōu dào nǐ de yóu jiàn.
grammar.english: I've already received your email.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de chē liàng hěn duō.
grammar.english: There are lots of vehicles here.

grammar.pinyin: Shàng fēi jī zhī qián qǐng xiān guān jī.
grammar.english: Please power off before boarding the plane.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ kāi huì de shí hou huì zuò bǐ jì.
grammar.english: I take notes during meetings.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ yòng xìn yòng kǎ fù kuǎn.
grammar.english: I pay by credit card.

grammar.pinyin: Míng tiān wǒ qǐng kè ba.
grammar.english: Let me treat you tomorrow.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men xiān chī fàn, jiē zhe qù kàn diàn yǐng.
grammar.english: We'll eat first, then go see a movie.

grammar.pinyin: Qǐng bāng wǒ dǎ yìn zhè fèn wén jiàn.
grammar.english: Please help me print this document.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī jīn píng guǒ.
grammar.english: I'd like to buy half a kilogram of apples.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men míng tiān zǎo shang chū fā.
grammar.english: We set off tomorrow morning.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn kě yǐ sǎo mǎ shōu kuǎn.
grammar.english: This shop can accept payment by QR code.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè lǐ hái yǒu kōng zuò wei ma?
grammar.english: Are there any seats free here?

grammar.pinyin: Zhè ge fáng zi zhèng zài chū zū.
grammar.english: This house is available to rent.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ gāng gang jiē dào yī ge diàn huà.
grammar.english: I just got a phone call.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè ge wǎng zhàn zhǎo dào le xìn xī.
grammar.english: I found the information on this website.

grammar.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ kōng píng zi fàng zài zhè lǐ.
grammar.english: Please put the empty bottle here.

grammar.pinyin: Sī jī shuō mǎ shàng jiù dào.
grammar.english: The driver said we'd arrive soon.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè zhǔn bèi xiū jià.
grammar.english: I'm planning to take leave next month.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang zài huā yuán sàn bù.
grammar.english: I walk in the garden every morning.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de jiāo tōng hěn fāng biàn.
grammar.english: Transportation here is very convenient.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ néng jiè nǐ de bǐ ma?
grammar.english: May I borrow your pen?

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ wàng dài yín háng kǎ, xiàn zài zhǐ yǒu zhè zhāng kǎ.
grammar.english: I forgot my bank card and only have this card now.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men xiǎng zhōu mò qù hǎi biān sàn bù.
grammar.english: We want to walk by the sea this weekend.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de gù kè hěn duō.
grammar.english: This shop has lots of customers.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xià bān yǐ hòu qù chāo shì mǎi cài.
grammar.english: I buy groceries at the supermarket after work.

grammar.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ kāi yī zhāng fā piào.
grammar.english: Please issue me an invoice.

grammar.pinyin: Gōng sī yǐ jīng tōng zhī dà jiā le.
grammar.english: The company has already notified everyone.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiān chá yí xià dì zhǐ.
grammar.english: I'll check the address first.

grammar.pinyin: Lù biān yǒu yī jiā biàn lì diàn.
grammar.english: There's a convenience store by the road.

grammar.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu kòng de shí hou guò lai ba.
grammar.english: Come over when you have time.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men zuò chuán qù nà ge dǎo.
grammar.english: We take a boat to that island.

grammar.pinyin: Tā zhù zài wǔ céng.
grammar.english: He lives on the fifth floor.

grammar.pinyin: Qǐng zuò zài zhè bǎ yǐ zi shàng.
grammar.english: Please sit on this chair.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men bǎ zhè xiē dōng xi fēn kāi fàng.
grammar.english: Let's put these things separately.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiē yǒu hěn duō cān tīng.
grammar.english: There are many restaurants on this street.

grammar.pinyin: Tā sòng le wǒ yī kuài shǒu biǎo.
grammar.english: He gave me a wristwatch.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ zài kā fēi diàn kàn bào zhǐ.
grammar.english: I read a newspaper at the café.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ men zài xué xiào de dà mén jiàn miàn.
grammar.english: We'll meet at the school gate.

grammar.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāng chǎng yǒu tíng chē chǎng.
grammar.english: This mall has a parking lot.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài shàng hǎi zū fáng zi.
grammar.english: I want to rent an apartment in Shanghai.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ gāng cái shōu dào nǐ de duǎn xìn.
grammar.english: I just received your text message.

grammar.pinyin: Qǐng guān yí xià dēng.
grammar.english: Please switch off the light.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ zài shǒu jī shàng kàn dào zhè ge guǎng gào.
grammar.english: I saw this ad on my phone.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ bǐ jì běn fàng zài zhuō zi shàng.
grammar.english: I put the notebook on the desk.

grammar.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng huàn yī shuāng xié zi.
grammar.english: I want to exchange for another pair of shoes.
